scope: Original CardioFEM valve comparisons. Anatomical mesh, connectivity, thickness field and trajectories require local prototype files.
units: mm–kg–s in the CardioFEM reports, force mN and stress kPa.
kinematics: Native quad shell with top/bottom director kinematics and through-thickness quadrature. Elementwise reference shell thickness from MeshData.

data.status: quantitative comparison only; scientific acceptance not established

displacement.definition: Global nodal top-surface displacement, aligned by explicit node IDs; includes fixed anchors

deformed_geometry.definition: Common double-precision FEB reference coordinates plus independent nodal displacements

cauchy_stress.definition: Global spatial Cauchy tensor, arithmetic mean of all eight shell integration points; Frobenius/component errors include both symmetric off-diagonals; no nodal extrapolation or smoothing

green_lagrange_strain.definition: Reference Cartesian Green-Lagrange tensor, arithmetic mean of all eight shell integration points; Frobenius/component errors include both symmetric off-diagonals; no nodal extrapolation or smoothing

relative_volume.definition: Arithmetic mean integration-point determinant of deformation gradient

right_stretch_diagonal.definition: Arithmetic mean of per-integration-point diagonal entries of right stretch U=sqrt(I+2E); CSV Ux,Uy,Uz are not displacements

first_principal_cauchy_stress.definition: Arithmetic mean of per-integration-point FEBio exact_eigen first roots, including the unsorted diagonal/zero degenerate fallback; not a root of the mean tensor

first_principal_green_strain.definition: Arithmetic mean of per-integration-point FEBio exact_eigen first roots, including the unsorted diagonal/zero degenerate fallback; not a root of the mean tensor

chord_force_vector.definition: Ordered model chord records, global force vector from first endpoint toward second; duplicate records retained

contact_gap.definition: Facet arithmetic mean of FEBio contact-potential m_gap, not penetration gap; CardioFEM rows follow fingerprinted model contact-facet order

contact_pressure.definition: Facet arithmetic mean of quadrature traction magnitude, not signed normal traction; CardioFEM rows follow fingerprinted model contact-facet order

contact_area.definition: Sum of current quadrature area where primary contact traction norm is nonzero

contact_support.definition: Facet support where arithmetic mean traction magnitude is strictly positive; no threshold tuning

limitations: XPLT time and field values are float32; time tolerance covers storage rounding only.
Reference provenance is checked against audited units/mesh/connectivity; XPLT does not embed the FEB model SHA256.
Matching tensor means does not compare through-thickness distributions; raw FEBio integration-point tensors are unavailable.
CSV principal averages reproduce FEBio exact_eigen branching but not bitwise arithmetic; near-degenerate root sensitivity remains a numerical caveat.
Contact gap depends on FEBio search/first-qualifying-pair traversal; differences may include search ordering.
Scientific acceptance tolerances and full-target convergence must be assessed separately.

numerical_differences: Shell iteration operator selected explicitly; residual and output stress always unchanged
Exact follower-pressure derivative rather than symmetric approximation
Contact derivative includes current-area variation with frozen candidate pairs per Krylov solve
Newton/backtracking plus GPU GMRES rather than FEBio BFGS/Pardiso
Residual-based tolerances and adaptive cutbacks are explicit run settings
